items.title: Musica
relevant_lines: Scopri come candidarti gratuitamente per lavorare come cantante, musicista e altre figure artistiche legate al mondo della musica!
Audizioni Opera e Lirica a Roma: cercasi cantanti lirici e professori d’orchestra — soprani, mezzosoprani, tenori, baritoni, bassi.
Selezioni aperte per artisti del settore musicale e lirico.
items.auto_review_reason: The stable Musica category explicitly covers singers and music professionals and currently lists an opera-singer audition with named voice types. The publisher self-identifies as a general casting portal that accepts externally submitted notices and warns that not all third-party notices are fully reliable; therefore it is approved only as a high-value third-party discovery source, never as an official publisher.
items.review_notes: Discovery-only. Verify each opportunity against the original organizer before publication. The current Opera e Lirica listing reports an application deadline of 2026-11-13 and an audition on 2026-11-17 in Rome, but no first-party organizer notice was found in this audit; do not add it to data/opportunities.json.
